## Checklist

- [ ] I have read and understood [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format
- [ ] My commit includes a `-s` / `--signoff` line (DCO signing)
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for any new public API
- [ ] All tests pass locally: `cmake --build --preset asan && ctest --preset tests`
- [ ] This PR addresses a single, focused change (one feature or bug fix per PR)

## What type of PR is this? (check all that apply)

- [ ] **feat** — new feature
- [ ] **fix** — bug fix
- [ ] **docs** — documentation only
- [ ] **refactor** — code restructuring with no feature/behavior change
- [ ] **test** — adding or updating tests
- [ ] **ci** — CI / build system changes only
- [ ] **chore** — maintenance tasks

## Description

> Describe what this PR does, why it is needed, and how it works.

## Related issues

> Link any related GitHub issues, e.g. "Fixes #123"

## Phase milestone

> Which NimRTC phase does this belong to? (P0 / P1 / P2 / P3 / P4)
